cards.back:
True: passage explicitly confirms the statement.
False: passage contradicts the statement.
Can't Tell: passage doesn't give enough information — you're guessing.

cards.front: Key VR Strategy: Scan, Don't Read
cards.back: Read the question first, then scan the passage for keywords. Don't read the whole passage before seeing the question — it wastes precious time (~28 seconds per question).
'Can't Tell' doesn't mean 'I don't know the answer.' It means the passage doesn't provide enough information to determine whether the statement is true or false.
44 questions in 22 minutes = ~30 seconds per question. If a passage is too difficult, flag it and move on. Never leave questions blank — always guess.
Watch for: 'all' vs 'some', 'always' vs 'sometimes', 'causes' vs 'associated with', 'most' vs 'all'. These qualifiers change whether a statement is true, false, or can't tell.
Passages cover: philosophy, economics, sociology, science, history, social issues. You don't need prior knowledge — all answers are found in the passage itself.
